24.original: Weaken Gulg knockers, then capture them with coils of wire.

25.original: Deliver the captured knockers to Gratt.

48.original: I've just about bloody had it! No more! I'll not stand by and see another theft go unanswered!

49.original: Eh? What am I angry about!? Well, it's them blasted knockers, ain't it!

50.original: Those grabby bastards latch onto anything─ore, hammers, my favorite bloody pick─and drag it back to their nests! And what for, I ask you!? The little buggers don't even have the concept of value!

51.original: I swear there'll be no end to this until I teach 'em the error of their ways. Here's the deal, friend: help me catch some of those thieving pests, and I'll see you paid for the trouble. You in?

52.original: Good. I'll be going south, so you head east until you find a couple of knockers to knock about. Once they're reeling, use this wire to bind those wriggling limbs of theirs, then bring them back here to the village.

53.original: Take that wire, and snare me a couple of knockers! There's a nest of the sneaky blighters over to the east!

54.original: Back already, eh? I managed to catch a few myself, but let's see your haul.

56.original: If I'm being honest, I was worried that <hex:020967E948FF0C616E206F75747369646572FF0C616E206F75747369646572FF0861206477617266FF0C616E206F75747369646572FF0C616E206F75747369646572FF0C616E206F75747369646572FF0C616E206F75747369646572FF0C616E206F7574736964657203> unfamiliar with the area might walk <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603> straight into a pack of hungry iguanas. Glad you proved me wrong!

57.original: ...Now, my prehensile pretties! Uncle Gratt is going to teach you to stop stealing ore from the Tholls...and start nicking it from the Goggs instead! Mwahahaha!
